d5Content.editDescription: The title shows on your channel and in search. Visibility decides who can watch.
d5Content.linkCopyFailed: Couldn't copy the link. Open the video and copy it from the address bar.
d5Content.overlays.intro: Choose which alerts show on stream, then add your overlay links to OBS as browser sources.
d5Content.links.title: Overlay links
d5Content.links.intro: One link for each overlay. Anyone with a link sees that overlay, so keep them off stream.
d5Content.links.alerts.name: Alerts
d5Content.links.alerts.hint: Tips, follows, subs and raids as they happen.
d5Content.links.chat.name: Chat
d5Content.links.chat.hint: Your chat on a clear background.
d5Content.links.goals.name: Goals
d5Content.links.goals.hint: Progress bars for your open goals.
d5Content.links.urlHint: Shown once. Copy each link now. Creating new links replaces all three.
d5Content.links.hidden: Your links were shown when you created them. To see them again, create new links: the old ones stop working.
d5Content.links.obsTitle: How to add a link in OBS
d5Content.links.obs.1: In OBS, under Sources, click + and choose Browser.
d5Content.links.obs.3: Set Width and Height to the size shown for that link.
d5Content.links.obs.4: Click OK, then send a test alert to check it shows.
d5Content.links.rotateBody: All three current links stop working at once. Paste the new ones into OBS.
d5Content.links.revokeBody: Alerts, chat and goals stop showing in OBS until you create new links.
d5Content.links.createdToast: Overlay links created. Copy them now: they're shown once.
